banglaExplanation: ভালো facilitator নিজে প্রশ্ন করে, learners-দেরও প্রশ্ন করতে উৎসাহ দেয়।
সাত ধরনের প্রশ্ন: open, closed, direct, indirect, leading, factual, probing।
Open question আলোচনা বাড়ায়; closed question শুধু confirmation দেয়।
Leading, trick বা double barrel প্রশ্ন এড়িয়ে চলুন।

example.bn: IT ক্লাসে 'ফাইল সেভ হলো না কেন মনে হয়?': এটা open question।
example.en: In an IT class, the trainer asks why the file did not save. This open question starts discussion.

cites.quote: Types of questions to avoid • Leading questions • Double-barrel questions • Questions with unfamiliar terms • Irrelevant questions

keyPoints.text: Avoid leading, double-barrel, unfamiliar-term and irrelevant questions.

cites.quote: Trick questions • Unethical questions • 'too hard' or 'too easy' questions

keyPoints.text: Also avoid trick, unethical, and 'too hard' or 'too easy' questions.

cites.quote: Leading questions These lead to the answer you are expecting or wanting. • Presumably you would check the safety requirements now? • I take it you have done this before? • Do you think it would be wise to seek advice before proceeding?

keyPoints.text: This is a leading question: 'Do you think it would be wise to seek advice?'

cites.quote: Factual questions These are used to confirm knowledge, and can be used to check if learners can recall facts. • What are the four principles of assessment? • Who wrote Romeo and Juliet?

keyPoints.text: 'Who wrote Romeo and Juliet?' is a factual question.
